name: ai.partsgraph/etim-json
description: Query the ETIM classification model — search classes, resolve features, units and values — from a locally converted, ODC-BY-attributed model file. Read-only; ships no ETIM data.

environmentVariables.name: ETIM_JSON_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a converted etim-json model file (see `etim-json fetch`). Required: the server exits without a model. To try the tool with no data, run `npx -y etim-json mcp --demo` instead, which loads a clearly-marked synthetic model.
